decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management line, so carrying it costs little, and its steady presence on the website suggests the option is still worth holding.

The cleaning centrifuge shares engineering and service resources with the established filtration business, so keeping it while its value unfolds is cheap and consistent with the firm's sustainability strategy.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's conveying range with low incremental carrying cost, and nothing in the evidence suggests the option has resolved unfavorably.

The hinged belt chip conveyor sits close to the core offer and has remained listed, so it is a low-cost option worth keeping even though the firm holds many other options and recently pruned products C and E.
